text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Archipelago(x) ::: x is an archipelago.
Continent(x) ::: x is a continent.
Premises:
NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
Settlement(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
Location(barutinCove, southwestCoastOfSnowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Location(southwestCoastOfSnowIsland, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Island(snowIsland) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
Archipelago(southShetlandIslands) ∧ Location(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ Location(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ Location(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
Continent(antarctica) ∧ Location(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
∀x ∀y ∀z (Location(x, y) ∧ Location(y, z) → Location(x, z)) ::: If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C.
Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Location(x, antarctica) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ Settlement(y) ∧ Bulgarian(y)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
